title: Cybersecurity company Xint says it found RCE vulnerabilities in Nginx using GPT 6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna; Wiz says it had separately found the same flaws (Thomas Brewster/Forbes)
summary: Thomas Brewster / Forbes: Cybersecurity company Xint says it found RCE vulnerabilities in Nginx using GPT 6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna; Wiz says it had separately found the same flaws — Darpa-backed cyber company tells Forbes its AI is finding all kinds of vulnerabilities, including one in NGINX, a massively popular web server tool.
